intro: Every photograph on this page is a roof we actually installed, on a street somewhere in the Miami Valley — no stock photography, no borrowed portfolios. Most of them have our yard sign in the frame, which is rather the point: if you live in Kettering or Centerville or Bellbrook, there is a fair chance you have driven past one of these. Look at the ridges, the valleys, and the cut lines around the vents and chimneys. That is where you can tell whether a crew was in a hurry.
